channel.title: NET Law-Verse Blog
channel.description: UGC NET Law (058), Paper 1, CLAT PG, AILET LLM and AIBE exam updates, legal current affairs and study guides.

item.title: Age of Consent and POCSO: Law Commission 283rd Report
item.description: Age of consent explained: POCSO, Section 63 BNS, Law Commission's 283rd Report (2023), adolescent relationships, mandatory reporting and both sides.

item.title: Anti-Conversion Laws: State Acts and Article 25
item.description: State anti-conversion laws explained: Stainislaus (1977), Hadiya, Supreme Court notices on laws in 12 States, UP and Rajasthan Acts, both sides.

item.title: Anti-Defection Law: Speaker Delay and Tenth Schedule
item.description: Anti-defection law explained: Tenth Schedule, Kihoto Hollohan, the 3-month rule, the 2025 Telangana order and the debate on the Speaker's role.

item.title: Arbitration Rulings 2026: Pre-Deposit, Seat, Appointment
item.description: Arbitration rulings 2026 explained: 10% pre-deposit reference, unilateral appointment under Article 14, seat with two venues, non-signatories, Section 9 fraud.

item.title: Article 370 Verdict and J&K Statehood Debate
item.description: Article 370 verdict (Dec 2023) explained: Article 370(3), Ladakh, the statehood assurance, pending restoration petitions and the arguments on each side.

item.title: Bulldozer Justice: Demolition Guidelines Explained
item.description: Bulldozer justice explained: the Supreme Court's November 2024 demolition guidelines, 15-day notice, hearing, video recording and the arguments on both sides.

item.title: CAA 2019 and Section 6A: Citizenship Law Debate
item.description: CAA 2019 and Section 6A explained: CAA Rules 2024, pending challenges, the 2024 Section 6A verdict, Assam NRC and the arguments on each side.

item.title: Caste Census 2027 and the 50% Reservation Cap
item.description: Caste enumeration in Census 2027 explained: 14 August 2026 notification, 40 questions, the Indra Sawhney 50% cap, Bihar and Telangana surveys and the debate.

item.title: Collegium vs NJAC: Who Should Appoint Judges?
item.description: Collegium vs NJAC explained: the Judges Cases, the 99th Amendment struck down in 2015, the Memorandum of Procedure and arguments for and against reform.

item.title: Criminal Defamation: Section 356 BNS and the Debate
item.description: Criminal defamation explained: Subramanian Swamy (2016), Section 356 BNS, the 2025 oral remarks on decriminalising and arguments for keeping or ending it.

item.title: Compensation for Custodial Violence: 2026 Rulings
item.description: 2026 custodial violence rulings: Lahra Bai Tamre (CBI probe, Rs 25 lakh), Daudayal, Hari Dutta Sharma and Suda Suresh, explained for Article 21.

item.title: Domicile Quotas in Private Jobs: Haryana Act Debate
item.description: Local-resident job quotas explained: Haryana's 75% law, the 2023 High Court ruling, Articles 14, 16 and 19, Dr Pradeep Jain and both sides of the debate.

item.title: DPDP Act vs RTI: Section 44(3) Challenge
item.description: DPDP Act and RTI explained: Section 44(3), Section 8(1)(j), the February 2026 larger bench reference, Rule 23 and the privacy versus transparency debate.

item.title: Unpaid E-Challans: Supreme Court Impound Order 2026
item.description: S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India (2026): Supreme Court directs States to impound vehicles with unpaid e-challans. Due process and Motor Vehicles Act explained.

item.title: Electoral Bonds Struck Down: Political Funding Debate
item.description: Electoral bonds judgment explained: ADR v. Union of India (2024), voters' right to know, Section 182 Companies Act, SBI disclosure and reform options.

item.title: Governor's Assent to Bills: Presidential Reference Opinion
item.description: Presidential Reference (Nov 2025) explained: no judicial timelines for Governors, no deemed assent, limited mandamus, Article 200 options, Tamil Nadu case.

item.title: Grounds of Arrest in Writing: Jaskaran Deol 2026
item.description: Jaskaran Deol (2026): arrest without written grounds is illegal under Article 22(1), no prejudice needed. Release, re-arrest and compensation rules explained.

item.title: GST Arrest Rules: Sunil Biyani Ruling 2026
item.description: Sunil Biyani (2026): GST arrest under Section 69 needs a communicated order and reasons to believe; no arrest to force ITC reversal. Bail rules explained.

item.title: Hijab in Schools: Split Verdict and Article 25
item.description: Hijab case explained: Karnataka High Court, the 2022 Supreme Court split verdict, essential religious practices test, Article 25 and both sides' arguments.

item.title: Removing a Judge: Yashwant Varma Inquiry Explained
item.description: How a judge is removed: Article 124(4), Judges (Inquiry) Act 1968, the Yashwant Varma inquiry committee's reported findings and past impeachment cases.

item.title: Madrasah Staff Appointments: Najma Khatun Ruling 2026
item.description: Najma Khatun (2026): Supreme Court dismisses 49 petitions by madrasah staff appointed after its 2016 stay. Why irregular public appointments fail, explained.

item.title: Marital Rape Exception: Section 63 BNS Challenge
item.description: Marital rape exception explained: Section 63 BNS, Independent Thought, the Delhi High Court split, the Union's stand and the Supreme Court's final hearing.

item.title: MMDR Amendment Act 2026: State Mineral Taxes Explained
item.description: MMDR Amendment Act 2026 explained: new Section 9D limits State taxes on mineral rights, deems past levies invalid and responds to MADA v. SAIL (2024).

item.title: Monsoon Session 2026: All New Acts Explained
item.description: Monsoon Session 2026 Acts in one place: Tribunals Reforms, Public Examinations, Births and Deaths, Keralam, MMDR, MSME and more, with exam notes.

item.title: One Nation One Election: Bill, JPC and the Debate
item.description: One Nation One Election explained: Kovind committee, 129th Amendment Bill, JPC status, Articles 82A, 83 and 172, and the federalism arguments.

item.title: Online Content Blocking: Section 69A and Sahyog Portal
item.description: Online content blocking explained: Section 69A, Blocking Rules, Shreya Singhal, Section 79(3)(b), the Sahyog portal and the X Corp case.

item.title: Places of Worship Act 1991: Challenge and Debate
item.description: Places of Worship Act 1991 explained: 15 August 1947 cut-off, Ayodhya exception, pending challenges and the December 2024 interim order on surveys.

item.title: PMLA and ED Powers: Vijay Madanlal and the Debate
item.description: PMLA and ED powers explained: Vijay Madanlal (2022), Section 45 bail conditions, Section 19 arrest, Pankaj Bansal, the review and the criticisms.

item.title: Same-Sex Marriage in India: Supriyo Judgment Explained
item.description: Same-sex marriage in India: Supriyo Chakraborty (2023), Special Marriage Act, the Cabinet Secretary committee, dismissed review and both sides' arguments.

item.title: SC/ST Sub-Classification and Creamy Layer Debate
item.description: SC/ST sub-classification explained: Davinder Singh (2024), the SC/ST creamy layer question, the Centre's 2026 stand and arguments on each side.
